item.title: 3-month-old Detroit Zoo giraffe dies after suffering injury
item.description: A giraffe born last fall at the Detroit Zoo has died after suffering a severe injury earlier this week.According to the zoo, Okidi, who was born on Nov. 23, 2025, ran into a habitat viewing panel before the zoo opened.
